title: Spotify Integration Not Working
body:
### The problem

Regardless of using the yaml or oauth approach neither result in a working integration. The yaml + devloper app approach completes the spotify application approval and the HA application credentials approval process and asks which room the device should be placed. The entity however stays in an unavailable state.

The oauth approach completes asking for the spotify application access but then the integration wizard spins for a bit and then results with empty window with no information whatsoever and the device/entity is not added, soon the spotify auto discover will find it again and process will repeat.

Attempts to roll back to previous versions where the integration was working fail because one of the steps I tried along the way was to remove the developer application and re-create it. Re-setting up the integration on recent versions have the same results.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant Core 2022.6.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

Not clear

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Spotify

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/spotify/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

When I delete and Install the Spotify Integration again, using the credentials I created on de dev spotify website I get the pop-up window from nabucasa OAuth: Done! Your account is now linked.
Next i get:

Any idea where to look for a solution?

comments.author: participant7
comments.body:
Had been having similar issues with "max tries reached", "update of media player is taking over 10 seconds", and "entity is disabled" by default after adding the integration.

Enabled entity, took a little bit longer than expected for it to appear, was functional on some level but had an extreme delay/not always receiving the commands problems. I notice in the logbook status that the entity every few minutes during testing status back and forths between "unavailable" and "idle"

Looked through a bunch of similar threads/reports, decided to try "developer" set up. Reloaded the integration beforehand just in case, then used an old spotify developer app that was previously used for mycroft (never use any spotify dev app before with home assistant) and changed the redirect URI to my home assistant 2022.6.6 (docker container)'s IP/URI (https://192.168.0.123:8213/redirect/oauth).

And now spotify through home assistant works as expected. (edit: for about an hour until integration needed reloading again)

It's worth noting that I did *not* do anything more towards replacing my original integration with the dev app *besides* giving a dev app in spotify the URI. I didn't even get to removing and re-adding the integration, and I have no manual oauth information in my application credentials.

Edit: I appear to have spoken too soon, it worked very well for about an hour but now the same problems have started again. Reloading the integration seems to get it working again. Is there a way to automate reloading of an integration?

I just wanted to add - not sure if this will help at all; but I built a node watcher within NodeRed that any time an entity goes "unavailable" - to send me a phone notification about which entity and an included timestamp. I originally designed this to keep an eye on my Zigbee and ZWave lights and switches; but it works for all my entities.

Several times per day; my media_player.spotify_<account> often drops out and I get the notification. I do not get any Supervisor or Core logs on the event (entity changing to unavailable); however - but this would be useful to tell me why it does this.

Are these 404 / network communication errors (error 429?) causing it to change to unavailable? I am not sure; as there's no logs to tell. But it is reproducing on its own; that's for sure.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Code 429 from spotify api is rate-limiting because of too many requests: https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/guides/rate-limits/

Maybe also relevant: https://community.spotify.com/t5/Spotify-for-Developers/How-to-avoid-getting-Error-429/td-p/5082798

@participant11 Based on the TypeError is see in my HA Logs frequently i think the integration may not handle code 429 very well and because of that goes into unavailable state. But the fact that code 429 is the response also means the integration sends too many (unknown limit) requests in an unknown certain timeframe.
When i have time this weekend i may have a look at the integration and try to access the Spotify API with the same access credentials to see what the integration gets back / how long it works.

comments.body:
I've just got mine working again using my old Spotify developer app (~hopefully not just temporarily~ seems to be working consistently for weeks).

**Steps I took:**
1. Delete the Spotify integration
2. Delete any Spotify related application credentials from here (if you have any): http://homeassistant.local:8123/config/application_credentials (This step I'd never tried before)
3. Grab my client ID and secret from the Spotify developer console (take a look at the Spotify integration docs if you're unfamiliar)
4. ~Add these to configuration.yml _(I'm not sure if this step is required since application credentials is a thing in the UI, but I did this anyway)_~
5. Add the same ID and secret to application credentials here: http://homeassistant.local:8123/config/application_credentials for Spotify
6. Install the spotify integration
7. Choose your new application credential option (**not** the HA cloud option)
8. Go to the new spotify device, and enable the entity (see this comment for details on enabling the entity: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/73319#issuecomment-1194425063)

Edit: You may have different redirect requirements depending on your own HA setup, have a look at this comment if so: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/73319#issuecomment-1197978294

In my case, I had control of media and volume, and working spotcast automations instantly after doing the above steps. I haven't had these working in months. _Hopefully this isn't just intermittent luck, but my guess is the old spotify application_credentials was messing with my attempts at using the HA cloud initialisation 🤞_

> configuration.yml example


```yml
spotify:
   client_id: !secret spotify_client_id
   client_secret: !secret spotify_client_secret
```
